articles.title: Polymarket US trading volume jumps 266% despite regulatory battles
articles.snippet: Trading volume on Polymarket’s US exchange surged from June to October, fueled by sports betting, even as the platform faces mounting regulatory scrutiny.

articles.title: Poland’s lower house backs sanctions bill covering crypto freezes
articles.snippet: The bill is now before the Senate and would broaden the grounds for adding people and companies to Poland’s national sanctions list.

articles.title: AI Data Centers Are Buying Used Jet Engines as New Power Turbines Take Six Years
articles.snippet: A shortage of new gas turbines is pushing AI developers toward refurbished power equipment and jet-engine-based generators, even as high prices, pollution concerns, and permitting delays threaten their expansion plans.

articles.title: AI Chip Stocks Bounce After Global Rout—But Is the Bubble Starting to Burst?
articles.snippet: A Friday rebound offered relief after a historic selloff. The question now is whether politics and mounting debt could turn an AI correction into something much worse.
